body_markdown:
As the largest supplier of uncrewed aircraft systems (UAS) in Latvia and the Baltics, Redwire is proud to participate in The Rīga Conference and to display our[Penguin UAS](https://rdw.com/product-archive/uncrewed-systems/) and[Octopus payloads](https://rdw.com/product-archive/octopus-isr-and-optics-payloads/) at this premier regional event. Redwire Defense Tech leadership will also participate on panel discussions at an exclusive pre-conference Business Forum:


**Date:** 9 September 2026


**Time** : 15:15-16:15


**Location:** Small hall, University of Latvia


**Business Forum Plenary Discussion: *Defence, Dual-Use Innovation and New Industrial Opportunities***


Europe’s renewed focus on security and defence is creating one of the fastest-growing industrial ecosystems of the coming decade. Beyond traditional defence companies, opportunities are emerging for businesses developing advanced manufacturing, digital solutions, AI, cybersecurity, logistics and other dual-use technologies. Stronger collaboration between industry, governments, research institutions and international partners can help Latvian and Baltic companies access new markets, funding opportunities and global supply chains.


- **Jānis Garisons** , Chief Executive Officer NEWT21
- **Mārcis Dzelme** , Research Fellow at the Think Tank “LV PEAK”, University of Latvia
- **Natalja Lernere** , Senior Business Development Manager at Redwire Defense Tech
- Moderator: **Louise Tumchewics** , Assistant Professor, Royal Danish Defence College, Institute for Military Technology


**Date:** 9 September 2026


**Time:** 16:30–17:30


**Location:** Small hall, University of Latvia


**Business Forum Plenary Discussion: *What Must Governments and Businesses Do Together in the Competing Global Economy?***


Strengthening economic resilience requires a shared vision and coordinated action across government, business and international partners. Closer cooperation can help improve the investment climate, support strategic industries, strengthen public-private partnerships and create the conditions for sustainable economic growth. A forward-looking perspective on the priorities that will shape Latvia’s competitiveness and resilience in an increasingly complex geopolitical environment.


- **Airis Rikveilis** , State Secretary of the Ministry of Defence of the Republic of Latvia
- **Vita Balode Andrews,** Director of the Export and Innovation Services Department Investment and Development Agency of Latvia
- **Balkan Devlen** , Co-Founder and Principal, Pendulum Geopolitical Advisory
- **Joshua Stinson** , Co-President & Chief Growth Officer, Redwire Defense Tech
- Moderator: **Rebecca Christie,** Senior Fellow at Bruegel


Visit[The Rīga Conference we](https://rigaconference.lv/) bsite for more details and the full program schedule.
